intro: APT33, CyberAv3ngers, and Interlock were the most frequently observed threat actors targeting critical infrastructure between April 12 and June 11, 2026, according to 23 articles. The period saw 14 high-severity and 3 critical-severity incidents, with CVE-2026-24032 (CVSS 7.3) among the top vulnerabilities. Affected sectors included energy, utilities, and manufacturing, while reported regions spanned the United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and North America.
